Hello! I saw your recent illustration, and I love your art style! It's super adorable! I was hoping that you would take on my request to draw one of my OCs.

Her name is Bella, and she is a teddy bear punk. She loves plushies and cats, and her expressions can be very dynamic. She is also a bit of a brat, but she is also a very loving character.

You may draw her however you feel like! You may choose the pose and expression. Her details can be reduced down if you find them a little too complicated. Her hoodie can also be raised or lowered if you'd like. If you want to include some elemental design, she is a very electric girl. 

Thank you so much for your consideration! 💜🩷
